universe.title: Warhammer 40,000
universe.description: The grimdark future of the 41st millennium, where humanity clings to survival amidst endless war against alien races, chaos, and mutation. The Imperium of Man spans thousands of worlds, ruled by the god-emperor on the Golden Throne of Terra.

imperium.description: The Imperium of Man, spanning 1,000+ worlds, ruled by the God-Emperor from Terra. The most powerful human faction, comprising the Adeptus Astartes, Imperial Guard, Adeptus Mechanicus, and countless other organizations.

military_branches.adeptus_astartes: Space Marines - genetically enhanced superhuman warriors
military_branches.imperial_guard: Imperial Army - billions of human soldiers

chaos.description: The forces of Chaos, serving the Ruinous Powers: Khorne (blood and battle), Tzeentch (change and magic), Nurgle (decay and disease), and Slaanesh (excess and pleasure). Corrupted humans, traitor legions, and daemonic entities.

orks.description: A savage, warlike alien race that thrives on combat. Orks grow like fungi, are fast-healing, and fight with crude but effective technology. Their WAAAGH! field allows their technology to function through belief.

government.structure: Might makes right - strongest Ork leads

necrons.description: Ancient alien race of living metal, awakened from their tomb worlds. Immortal, regenerating, wielding gauss technology that disintegrates matter at the molecular level. Seek to reclaim their ancient empire.

eldar.description: The Aeldari, an ancient and dying race. Once masters of the galaxy, they now survive on Craftworlds connected by the Webway, trying to avoid Slaanesh's attention while fighting for survival.

tyranids.description: An alien hive mind from the Galaxies' Edge, consuming all biomass. Tyranids are a biological weapon of mass destruction, evolving new organisms to counter any threat. The Hive Fleet seeks to consume the Milky Way.

eras.name: Age of Strife
eras.description: The Dark Age of Technology when humanity reached its zenith before the Warp storms destroyed much of the Imperium

eras.name: The Great Crusade
eras.description: The Emperor's campaign to reunite humanity across the stars using the Space Marine Legions

eras.name: Horus Heresy
eras.description: The greatest betrayal in human history as Horus Lupercal and half the Legions turned to Chaos

eras.name: Age of Apostasy
eras.description: Calderean Heresy and the rise of the Inquisition

eras.name: Age of Darkness
eras.description: Centuries of decline, the Indomitus Crusade begins to turn the tide

eras.name: 41st Millennium
eras.description: The current era - the grimdark future where war is all
